title: Debts
intro: A debt is a record between you and a friend, signed on both phones.
stillValid: A change you sent stays valid if your friend signs it later. It adds only that change.
clearPending: You can clear this debt once its payment or netting is done.
repayNote: Your payment is sent only after your friend signs that it repays this debt.
orphaned: Made with an earlier identity of this phone. Your friend's phone still has it.
settlingDetail: The debt goes down for good once the payment settles.
recordHelp: Both phones show the same code when they agree.
signNote: Signing records this on both phones. Buckspay records it; it does not lend or collect.
viaCode: Anyone who sees the code can read this debt.
synced: Your friend's phone had newer changes. Check the debt and try again.

refused.locked: This debt is in a netting session or waiting for a payment. Try again after it ends.
refused.stale: Your friend's phone has a newer version of this debt.
refused.other: You already have a debt with this person.
refused.invalid: This offer could not be checked. Nothing was signed.

notSigned: {{peer}} has not signed this yet. Send it again, or make a new change.
paymentFailed: This payment failed. The debt is back to {{amount}}.
settleBefore: Settle or spend this payment before {{date}} for the debt to go down.
